name: Fighter Guardian
body:
Fighters train day-in and day-out to perfect their techniques and forms. The guardian focuses on defensive forms and achieves feats of protection outside the bounds of what other trained fighters may achieve,

Mettle (Ex)

At 1st level, a guardian gains a Mettle pool that is refreshed each day. The pool’s maximum is equal to their Constitution modifier, plus any feats and special abilities that increases the pool maximum. Some abilities may restore points to this pool during the day.

But the guardian may not have more points of Mettle than the pool’s maximum.

The guardian may expend Mettle to gain one of the following benefits.

As an immediate action they may gain a bonus equal to their Constitution modifier on the next non-Fortitude saving throw. The bonus must be used before the beginning of their next turn.
As part of making a Strength or Dexterity check to gain a bonus equal to their Constitution bonus on that check. The guardian may restore a point of Mettle to your pool in the following ways.
If they use the aid another action to assist an ally’s skill check and the ally would have failed the check without their action
If the guardian uses the aid another action to improve an ally’s AC and the ally would have been hit without the their action

If an ability which expends Mettle allows for the use of an attack of opportunity, the attack of opportunity allowed by that ability may be taken even while using the total defense action.

Valorous Deflection (Ex)

At 1st level, when an opponent makes a melee attack against the guardian or an adjacent ally, they can spend a point of Mettle and a use of an attack of opportunity to attempt to parry the attack. The guardian makes an attack roll as if they were making an attack of opportunity. For each size category the attacking creature is larger, the guardian takes a -2 penalty to this attack. If the attempt is made using a shield attack, the guardian may apply any enhancement or ability bonuses to shield AC to the attack. If the attack result is greater than the attackers, the attack automatically misses. The attempt must be declared before the results of the attack are known.

If this attack is made while they are using the Combat Expertise feat, fighting defensively, or taking the total defense action they may also add the bonus from those abilities to the attack roll to block an attack, but loses any used bonuses until the beginning of their next turn.

Upon a successful parry, if the guardian has at least one point of Mettle they may make a riposte attack on the creature they parried as an immediate action, provided the target is in their threatened area. If the parry attempt fails, the attack is instead directed at the guardian at its normal result and the guardian is flatfooted and loses their shield bonus to AC if the shield was used in the attempt. This replaces the bonus feat given at 1st level.

Behind Me (Ex)

At 2nd level, the guardian may elect to place themselves in the path of danger in order to protect an ally. When rolling initiative, the guardian may select a target as a charge. This selection may not change for the duration of the encounter. Any time that they are within 5 feet of their charge, and the charge is the target of an attack, the guardian may, as an immediate action, enter the square occupied by the charge and receive the attack in their place. The attack automatically hits the guardian. The charge is placed in any empty square adjacent to the guardian of their choice. The guardian may activate this ability after knowing whether their charge will be hit.

If the guardian suffers a critical hit as a result of using behind me they restore a point of Mettle.

This ability replaces the bravery granted at 2nd level.

Ever Vigilant (Ex)

At 6th level, all squares the guardian threatens with a melee weapon, including just a shield, are considered difficult terrain for enemies.

This ability applies even to jumping, flying, and incorporeal foes, as well as swarms, so long as the guardian wields a melee weapon or shield capable of affecting them. The guardian must be aware of the enemy to affect them.

The guardian also provides cover but not total cover to adjacent allies if their square lies between the ally and the origin of the attack or effect that includes the ally as a target.

This replaces the bravery granted at 6th level.

Active Defense (Ex)

At 7th level, a guardian may spend a point of Mettle as an immediate action to apply any shield bonus they benefit from to their CMD and touch AC for a number of rounds equal to their Constitution modifier. They may activate this ability even while grappled or otherwise restrained so long as they are still benefiting from a shield bonus.

Starting at 11th level, the guardian may apply this bonus to themselves and one adjacent ally.

Additionally, this ability now adds their shield bonus to Reflex saves during duration.

Starting at 16th level, the guardian’s shield bonus always applies to their own CMD, touch AC and Reflex saving throws. They may now expend a use of Mettle to apply this bonus to up to two adjacent allies.

If the guardian has levels in another class that provides this ability, their effective class levels stack.

This ability replaces the armor training granted at 7th level.

Always Ready (Ex)

At 7th level, whenever the guardian rolls for initiative they gain 2 bonus points of Mettle that exceeds their normal maximum. This Mettle is spent first if the guardian uses any abilities which require Mettle. If they spend no Mettle before the end of combat these bonus points disappear when combat ends. The bonus points of Mettle gained increases to 3 at 13th level and to 4 at 19th level. This ability does not stack with other instances of this ability, however, any class that provides this ability stack with this class to determine the number of bonus Mettle.

Bulwark (Ex)

At 10th level, the guardian has learned to defend against some kinds of magic. If they are armored or wielding a shield they may expend a point of Mettle and deflect a ray effect that targets them as an immediate action causing it to harmlessly dissipate.

If the guardian expends an additional point of Mettle they make a Reflex save against that ray using whatever the save DC vs the effect would normally be, even if it does not allow one. If the guardian succeeds they may redirect the ray to a target of their choice. The target must be within range of the spell as though the guardian was the point of origin. This redirection uses the same attack roll result by the original caster.

This ability replaces the bravery gained at 10th level.

Brace (Ex)

At 10th level, if the guardian succeeds on a Reflex save against a spell or effect while wielding a shield they may expend a point of Mettle as an immediate action to prevent that effect from affecting all squares adjacent to them as well as negating the effect fully on themselves.

This ability replaces the bonus feat granted at 10th level.

Implacable (Ex)

At 14th level, the guardian is no longer slowed by difficult terrain, whether natural, magical, or magically augmented. Additionally, they are not slowed by effects which reduce their base move speed, and become immune to the dazed and stunned conditions so long as they have at least 1 point of Mettle and remain conscious.

This ability replaces the bravery gained at 14th level.

Incredible Recovery (Ex)

At 18th level, the guardian’s ability to recover from injury is truly extraordinary. They gain fast healing 1 when not in combat. This cannot restore hit points lost to starvation, thirst, or suffocation nor does it reattach severed limbs. This replaces the bravery gained at 18th level.
